responsibility: This file implements GCC’s single-entry/single-exit region utilities for GIMPLE CFGs. It computes liveout SSA names for a region, resets debug uses that would otherwise refer to non-exported SSA names, creates and frees sese_info objects, inserts exit PHIs for liveouts when regions are wrapped in conditional form, moves a SESE region under an artificial if/else guard, answers invariance and scalar-evolution queries relative to the region, and provides debug printing helpers. Its responsibility is CFG/SSA support for region-based transformations such as Graphite rather than general loop analysis.
same_name_distinction: This implementation file provides the out-of-line SESE-region algorithms declared in gcc/sese.h: it computes liveouts, inserts exit PHIs, rewrites/debug-cleans uses that escape the region, moves regions under synthetic conditionals, and answers region-specific scalar-evolution and invariance queries. In contrast, gcc/sese.h primarily defines the SESE/ifsese data structures and inline membership and loop helpers.
